market.what: fluoropolymer polymer processing aids (active) for PE film, pipe, wire, world
market.method: bottom-up est.: 46 Mt LLDPE x ~65% film x ~70% PPA-treated = ~21 Mt x 500 ppm = ~10 kt x ~$35/kg (est.) = $370M, +~30% other extrusion; M&M says $1.53B (likely incl. masterbatch)

value.logic: today's PFAS-free PPAs need 0.1-0.3% vs 100-800 ppm FP and 20-60 min to clear melt fracture; a drop-in that matches FP keeps ~2% output on ~21 Mt film x ~$0.5/kg conversion value = ~$0.2B + lower dose ~$0.05B (est.)
value.revenue_logic: active sold to masterbatchers (Ampacet, Avient...) at ~2.5% share of ~$0.5B = ~$12M
value.margin_logic: specialty additive, cheap organic feedstocks, but many PFAS-free rivals push price

trend.drivers: PE film/flexible packaging growth; EU PPWR PFAS limit in food packaging; 3M exit from PFAS (Dynamar) end-2025
trend.deadline: EU PPWR PFAS limit in food-contact packaging from 12 Aug 2026

competition.notes: crowded: most masterbatchers launched PFAS-free PPAs 2023-2025; no molecule startup found; edge must be lower dose / faster clearing

lab.synth: catalog or 1-2 step custom (functional oligomer/amphiphile), 1-5 kg needed for film trials
lab.test: capillary rheometer melt-fracture onset (ASTM D3835) + lab blown-film time-to-clear at a compounder/polymer lab
lab.logic: synth 5 wk + compounding/rheology/film 5 wk; synth $10k + masterbatch + film line days ~$20k (est.)

sale.gates: converter line trials 6-12 mo; FDA food-contact + EU 10/2011 listing (new substance via EFSA adds 2-3 yrs); TSCA PMN
